Cut the noise. Find what matters.
The first AI-driven SOC platform that unifies proactive and reactive security to see every asset, threat and exposure with up to 99% less noise.
Learn more
Prevent attacks with a 3x Gartner Leader.
Legacy SIEMs leave you exposed, but Cortex XSIAM — with integrated XDR — keeps you safe. Recognized by Gartner
®
and Forrester
®
and proven in MITRE ATT&CK, it blocks the world’s most advanced threats.
Learn more
Your browser does not support HTML5 video.
Your browser does not support HTML5 video.
​​Uncover Every Threat, Instantly.
Start with better data — triple the EDR telemetry plus enriched firewall logs — and apply 2,900+ ML models to stop advanced attacks. With 13,300+ up-to-date detections, XSIAM’s always ready for what’s next.
Investigate in minutes, not hours.
Forget the swivel chair. Everything you need is in one place. AI turns thousands of alerts into a few prioritized cases and shows you the full attack story — including root cause — so you can make the right call, right away.
